summary: An informational memo from the Internet architecture community that makes two recommendations to improve Internet performance: test and widely deploy active queue management in routers, and keep working on better end-to-end congestion control. It was replaced by RFC 7567.

eli5.summary: When too many cars arrive at a toll booth, a smart booth starts warning drivers early instead of waiting for a huge traffic jam. This memo urges routers to do that.

questions: how to avoid internet congestion in routers
